source_text: ∆ηλονότι τῆς Ῥωμαϊκῆς στρατιᾶς τὴν ἀκαταγώνιστον χεῖρα. θεοῦ δέ φαμεν τὴν Ῥωμαϊκὴν στρατείαν, καθ' ὅ ἐστιν δεσπότης καὶ πάντων δημιουργός.
pass_a_gloss: Clearly of the Roman army the irresistible hand. Of God but we-say the Roman campaign, according as he-is master and of all creator.
pass_b_english: Clearly the irresistible hand of the Roman army. We call the Roman campaign God’s, inasmuch as he is Master and Creator of all (Matthew 22:7).

choices.why: Fragment reads the army as instrument under God’s mastery.
